ai_summary: ABB India Limited reports a strong Q2 CY2026, achieving record orders (up 50%) and robust revenue growth (21%), which boosted its order backlog by 22% and signals solid operational momentum. However, a significant red flag is the 10-11% year-on-year decline in H1 Profit Before Tax and Profit After Tax, largely attributed to margin compression and adverse non-operational factors like foreign exchange volatility, despite a healthy Q2 operational EBITA increase. The company also declared a special dividend, which includes proceeds from a recent Robotics divestment alongside H1 operational profits.
